caption: The drawing features a single upholstered armchair with a high backrest and wooden frame. The fabric covering the seat, back, and inner arms is predominantly green with blue undertones and displays a subtle, intricate pattern that resembles floral or paisley motifs. The arms, legs, and supporting stretchers of the chair are rendered in a brown wood tone, with the arms shaped in a gentle curve and the legs straight and square. The chair is positioned within a rectangular outlined border on a cream-colored background, and the artist's signature "Loughridge" appears in the lower left corner. There are no additional objects or decorative elements in the composition.
title: Side chair
